desc: Parse input and group items by vitamin type into three lists of (calorie, amount).
For each vitamin type, run a 0/1 knapsack with capacity X to compute dp[c] = max amount for exact cost c, then build prefix-max best[c] = max amount with cost ≤ c.
Implement feasible(target): for each type find smallest c with best[c] ≥ target (or INF if none), return True iff sum of three costs ≤ X.
Binary search target in [0, max(best1[X], best2[X], best3[X])] using feasible, keeping the highest feasible value.
Print the resulting maximum minimum vitamin intake.
